newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar December freight differentials.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar December freight differentials.

text.p: The London Internaitonal Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) issued new freight differentials for its white sugar contract to cover the December delivery period.

The exchange notice showed the following premiums - Inchon and Ulsan $3 a tonne ($4 in October), Bangkok/Kohsichang zero ($1), Guangzhou, Huangpu, Shekou and Xiamen all $2 ($3), Recife and Maceio $5 ($11),Santos $13 ($21), Imbituba/Itaji $11 ($19), Buenos Aires $9 ($17), New Orleans $7 ($11), Savannah $6 ($11), Matanzas $12 ($15) and Durban zero ($4).
Penang, Port Kelang and Singapore were $1 discount (zero).
